questions.question: Find the number which is as much greater than 49 as it is less than 95.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the number be x which is greater or less than 49 and 95 with same difference

According to the question

x - 49 = 95 - x

⇒ 2x = 144

⇒ x = 72

**∴ Number is 72**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

According to the question we have to find the middle number from 49 to 95, which is the average from 49 to 95

Required number = (49 + 95)/2 = 144/2 = 72

questions.question: Tanzeem spent 1/5 of his salary on his friends, 1/10 of his salary on accommodation, and 1/4 of his salary on savings. If he has Rs.1800 left, then find his total expenditure on accommodation and savings.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Tanzeem spent 1/5 of his salary on his friend

1/10 of the salary on accommodation

1/4 of the salary was his saving

The total salary left is Rs. 1800

**Formula used:**

Monthly salary = Saving + expenditure

**Calculation:**

Let the total salary of Tanzeem be x

Remaining amount = Total Amount - the amount spent from salary

Remaining amount = x - (1/5 + 1/10 + 1/4)x = 9x/20

So, 9x/20 = 1800

⇒ x = 4000

∴ Total expenditure on accommodation and savings = (1/10 + 1/4) × 4000 = Rs 1400

questions.question: What is the value of (2 - 2z + z²) (2 + 2z - z²), when z + 2/z = 2.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

z + 2/z = 2

**Calculation:**

z + 2/z = 2

⇒ z² + 2 = 2z

⇒ z² = 2z - 2

Putting z² = 2z - 2 we get,

(2 - 2z + z²) (2 + 2z - z²) = 0 × (2 + 2z - 2z + 2) = 0

**∴ Value of the given expression is 0**

questions.question: Determine the value of ‘x’ in the equation: x = sqrt {20 + sqrt {20 + sqrt {20 + sqrt {20 + ldots infty } } } }
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

 x = sqrt {20 + sqrt {20 + sqrt {20 + sqrt {20 + ldots infty } } } } 

⇒ x = √(20 + x)

Squaring both sides,

⇒ x² = 20 + x

⇒ x² - x - 20 = 0

⇒ x² - 5x + 4x - 20 = 0

⇒ x (x - 5) + 4 (x - 5) = 0

x = 5 as x cannot be negative.

**∴ The correct answer is 5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

If the given expression is like this sqrt {x + sqrt {x + sqrt {x + ldots infty } } } 

Then try to find its factors, and from the two factors which makes x the greater one will be the answer

Here,

x = 20 can be written as = 5 × 4

In this case, 5 is greater than 4 hence the answer will be 5

**∴ Value of x = 5**

questions.question: The point at which the perpendicular bisectors of the sides of a triangle intersect is known as
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The point of intersection of **perpendicular bisectors** of the sides of a triangle is the **circum-centre**.

Memory Aid for Triangle Centers:

1. **Perpendicular Bisectors** → **Circum-centre** (Center of circumcircle)

2. **Altitudes** → **Orthocentre**

3. **Medians** → **Centroid**

4. **Angle Bisectors** → **In-center** (Center of incircle)

**∴ The correct answer is circum-centre.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** A triangle with its **perpendicular bisectors** intersecting at a common point.

**Property Used:** The **circum-centre** is the point that is **equidistant** from all three **vertices** of the triangle, allowing a circle (the **circumcircle**) to pass through them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f1297a20ce1f73c703ec820bf2218a26811f2623fbc0d8b1ae8c46d58d304d.png] 

⇒ A **perpendicular bisector** is a line that divides a side into two equal parts and meets it at a **90° angle**.

⇒ In any triangle, the three perpendicular bisectors are **concurrent** (they meet at a single point).

⇒ This point of concurrency is called the **circum-centre**.

⇒ The distance from the circum-centre to any vertex is the **circum-radius** (R).

**∴ The correct answer is circum-centre.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Orthocentre

The point where the three **altitudes** (perpendiculars drawn from vertices to opposite sides) of a triangle intersect.

Centroid

The point where the three **medians** (lines connecting vertices to the midpoints of opposite sides) intersect; it divides each median in a **2:1 ratio**.

In-center

The point of intersection of the **internal angle bisectors**; it is the center of the **incircle** which touches all sides of the triangle.

Euler Line

In any non-equilateral triangle, the **orthocentre**, **centroid**, and **circum-centre** are collinear, and the centroid divides the distance between the other two in a **2:1 ratio**.</p

questions.question: The radius of the circle circumscribing the three vertices of an equilateral triangle is 12 cm. Determine the height (in cm) of the equilateral triangle.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4e09b7cff8a010909888e50e8bd1284a2438a7e02b7f31c000b901a31df0662.png] 

**Given:**

 the radius of the circum-circle of an equilateral triangle is 12 cm

**Concept used:** 

Median of a triangle divide itself in the ratio of 2 ∶ 1 at its centroid and in case of equilateral triangle centroid, circum-centre, in centre, ortho centre all lie at the Centre.

**Calculation:**

Let the height of the triangle be x

 radius of the circle circumscribing the three vertices of triangle

= (2/3) × x = 12

⇒ x = 18 cm

**∴ Height of the triangle is 18 cm**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

We know, radius of a circumcircle of an** **equilateral triangle is a/√3

Where, a be the sides of the triangle.

So, according to the question,

⇒ a/√3 = 12

⇒ a = 12√3 

So, the height of the equilateral triangle is √3/2 × 12√3 = 18 cm

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 5 : 4. If the sum of both the numbers is 180, then find the smaller number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of two numbers is 5 : 4. If the sum of both the numbers is 180

**Calculation:**

Let the two numbers be 5x and 4x

According to the question,

5x + 4x = 180

⇒ 9x = 180

⇒ x = 20

Smaller number = 4x = 4 × 20 = 80

**∴ the smaller number is 80**

questions.question: P started a business by investing Rs. 35000 and Q joined him after one year with an amount of Rs. 21,000. After two years from the starting of the business, they earned a profit of Rs. 26000. What will be P's share (in Rs.) of the profit?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P invest Rs. 35000 for 2 years, Q invest Rs. 21000 for 1 year

**Concept used:**

• Profit = Investment × Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

P : Q = 35000 × 24 : 21000 × 12 =10: 3

P’s share = (10/13) × 26000 = Rs. 20000

**∴ Share of P is Rs. 20,000.**

questions.question: If 31x + 31y = 403, then what is the average of x and y?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

31x + 31y = 403

**FORMULA USED:**

Average = sum of numbers/total numbers

**CALCULATION:**

According to the question,

⇒ 31(x + y) = 403

⇒ x + y = 403/31 =13

So, Average of x + y = 13/2 = 6.5

**∴ Average of x and y is 6.5**

questions.question: A sum of Rs 7500 is divided into two parts. The simple interest on the first part at the rate of 12% per annum is equal to the simple interest on the second part at the rate of 18% per annum. What is the Interest (in Rs) on first part for one year?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let the first part be x and second part be 7500 - x

According to the question,

S.I of x = S.I of (7500 - x)

⇒ (x × 12 × 1)/100 = [(7500 - x) × 18 × 1]/100

⇒ 2x = 3(7500 - x)

⇒ 2x = 22500 - 3x

⇒ 5x = 22500

⇒ x = 22500/5

x = 4500

So, first part is Rs. 4500 and second part is Rs. 3000

Interest on first part = (4500 × 12 × 1)/100 = Rs. 540

**∴ The interest on first part is Rs. 540**

questions.question: If Anuj walks at the speed of 4 km/hr, then he reaches his school 6 minutes late but if he walks at the speed of 5 km/hr, then he reaches 6 minutes before the scheduled time. What is the distance (in km) of his school from his house?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** **Formula used:**

Required distance is given by

D=(S₁× S₂)/(S₁-S₂)× (t₁-t₂)

Whichever is greater can be taken first from S₁ and S₂ same for t₁

and t₂ greater one is taken first in subtraction

**Calculation:**

Let the correct time be 't'

⇒ D = ((4× 5))/((5-4))×((t+6)-(t-6))/(60) (∵ 1 min = 1/60 hr)

⇒ D = 20 × 12/60 = 4

**∴ The required distance is 4 Km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] 

**__Alternate Method__**Let the distance between school from house is D

Actual time at which he must have reached school = t in minutes

According to the question,

4 = D/(t + 6)

⇒ D = 4 (t + 6) ----(i)

And,

⇒ D = 5(t - 6) ----(ii)

From eq. (i) and (ii)

4t + 24 = 5t - 30

t = 54 minutes

Distance, D = [4 × (54 + 6)]/60 = 4 km

∴ The required distance is 4 Km.

questions.question: In which year the number of students who passed with distinction was lesser than those who passed with distinction in the previous year?

Students Passed with Distinction

2012 = 7000

2013 = 1500

2014 = 3500

In 2011 students passed with Distinction = 2000

In 2012 Distinction students increased from 2011.

In 2013 Distinction students decreased from 2012.

In 2014 Distinction students increased from 2013.

In 2015 Distinction students increased from 2014.

**∴ The number of students who passed with distinction decreased in 2013.**

questions.question: The length and breadth of a rectangle are 24 cm and 7 cm respectively. What must be the length of its diagonal (in cm)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of rectangle = 24 cm

Breadth of rectangle = 7 cm

**Concept used:**

• Diagonal² = Leangth² + Breadth²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b586f91d80fa220b181899100e00cae4fae7cb8d10fc52abaa2d5adc502a5302.png] 

Length of diagonal = √(24² + 7²) = √(576 + 49) = √625 = 25 cm

**∴ Diagonal of the rectangle is 25 cm**
